Class FetchMetadataFilter

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.security.fetchmetadata.FetchMetadataFilter
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.micronaut.core.order.Ordered
@Requires(property="micronaut.security.fetch-metadata.filter.enabled", notEquals="false", defaultValue="true") @ServerFilter("${micronaut.security.fetch-metadata.filter.pattern:/**}") @Internal public final class FetchMetadataFilter extends Object implements io.micronaut.core.order.Ordered
Server filter that enforces the configured Fetch Metadata request-isolation policy.

It also adds Sec-Fetch-Site, Sec-Fetch-Mode and Sec-Fetch-Dest to the Vary header of the responses to the requests it evaluates, both allowed and rejected, because those responses depend on the Fetch Metadata request headers.

    • filterRequest

      @RequestFilter public @Nullable io.micronaut.http.HttpResponse<?> filterRequest(io.micronaut.http.HttpRequest<?> request)
      Evaluates the request against the configured Fetch Metadata rules.

      The first rule that returns FetchMetadataRuleResult.ALLOWED or FetchMetadataRuleResult.REJECTED decides the result. The filter denies the request when every rule returns FetchMetadataRuleResult.UNKNOWN.

      Parameters:
      request - the request to evaluate
      Returns:
      null to continue processing, or a forbidden response to reject the request
